description: Commission of Elections - S. M. Sriyani Fernando of the Puttalam Urban Council has vacated her office of member of that Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Puttalam Urban Council and Wennappuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral matters including vacating offices and candidate status.
